Your rental, personally represented

I am Idan, a representative of local rental companies. This is a personal agency service, not an automated price-comparison engine. The form helps us work efficiently; a person stays responsible for coordinating your request and helping you with the company.

My long-standing relationships and volume of bookings make me an important business partner to these companies. Whichever offer you choose, you book as Idan's client and receive my personal VIP service: clear explanations before booking, a named contact and help following up if a problem arises. This service is personal support, rather than a promise of a free upgrade or a change to the supplier's rental conditions.

My approach is straightforward: a clear quoted total, the deposit, selected extras and any relevant conditions explained before you commit. Ask me directly if anything is unclear.

title: Privacy Policy
seo_title: Privacy Policy | Poland Rent a Car
meta_description: Read how Poland Rent a Car uses the contact and travel details you provide to process a rental quotation request and contact relevant rental companies.
content:
We respect the privacy of users of poland-rent-car.com and take steps to protect the personal information provided through the website.

Information you provide

When you complete a car rental quotation request, we may collect your full name, email address, phone number, travel details, vehicle collection and return dates, number of passengers, vehicle preferences and any other information you choose to provide.

How we use the information

The information is used to process your request, prepare a quotation, contact you and check availability and conditions with relevant car rental companies.

Sharing information

Where necessary, some information may be shared with rental companies or relevant service providers solely to process your request and prepare a suitable offer.

We do not sell personal information to third parties or use it for purposes unrelated to handling your enquiry, unless you have consented or this is required by law.

Protecting information

We take reasonable measures to protect personal information and prevent unauthorised access.

Contact

For questions about this policy or information submitted through the website, email idanrentacar@gmail.com.

This English version reflects the existing Hebrew policy, last updated September 2026.
